transparency.tu: Hi! To ensure we are aligned on the details, I prepared this quote for you. Take a look and let me know if everything works for you before we confirm!

pro.tu: Hello, following our discussion, here is the detailed proposal. Feel free to reach out if you have any questions.
pro.vous: Hello, following our discussion, please find attached the detailed proposal. I remain at your disposal should you have any questions.

casual.tu: Hey! Here is the draft for our deal. Check to make sure I did not miss anything!
casual.vous: Hello! Here is the summary draft for our deal. Please verify that nothing was missed!

transparency.tu: Hi! As agreed, here is the official invoice with all my details and the exact breakdown. As soon as you are good with it, we move forward!
transparency.vous: Hello! As agreed, here is the official document with all business details and the itemized breakdown. As soon as confirmed, we proceed.

pro.tu: Hello, here is your detailed digital invoice. Thank you for your business and talk to you soon!
pro.vous: Hello, please find your detailed digital invoice attached. Thank you for your business and partnership!

casual.tu: Hey! Here is the clean order summary for your records.
casual.vous: Hello! Here is the complete order summary for your records.

transparency.tu: Payment received, thanks for your support! Here is your receipt to keep on your phone.
transparency.vous: Payment received with thanks! Here is your official receipt for your records.

pro.tu: Hello, we confirm receipt of your payment. Please find your receipt attached.
pro.vous: Hello, we confirm receipt of your payment. Please find your receipt attached.
